prompt: A teammate ran `rladmin status` and pasted the node table above. What does the 0/0 in the SHARDS column for node:2 tell you?
explanation: A node in maintenance mode shows a shards value of 0/0: maintenance mode migrated its shards to other nodes and marks the node so no shards or endpoints migrate back to it until `maintenance_mode off` restores them from the snapshot. The node is still healthy (STATUS OK), a merely empty node would show 0/100-style values because it can still accept shards, and there is no backups-only node class in Redis Software.
code:
CLUSTER NODES:
NODE:ID   ROLE     ADDRESS       SHARDS   STATUS
*node:1   master   172.17.0.2    2/100    OK
node:2    slave    172.17.0.4    0/0      OK
node:3    slave    172.17.0.3    4/100    OK

options.text: node:2 is in maintenance mode and cannot accept shards
node:2 has failed and must be replaced
The cluster simply has no databases yet
node:2 is reserved for backups only
